messages.content:
Solve the following multiple-choice mathematics problem. You may reason before answering. End your final response with exactly "ANSWER: X", where X is one of A, B, C, D, E. Select one option.

in a recent election , james received 0.5 percent of the 2,000 votes cast . to win the election , a candidate needed to receive more than 50 percent of the vote . how many additional votes would james have needed to win the election ?

A. 901
B. 989
C. 990
D. 991
E. 1,001

message.content:
James received 10 votes (0.5% of 2,000). To win he needed more than 1,000 votes, i.e., 1,001 votes. Additional needed: 1,001 − 10 = 991.

ANSWER: D
message.reasoning_content: James: 10 votes. Need >1000, so 1001 votes, additional 991. D.
